mechanics.claim: The impact deals damage, then the field ruptures after 1 second to deal the same physical damage again, meaning the ability hits twice.
mechanics.quote: The impact creates a field for 1 second that {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within, which then ruptures to deal the same {{as|physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shields only block a single instance of the two damage hits.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} will block only a single instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Damage against minions and monsters is capped based on their health.
mechanics.quote: Against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, the damage based on their health ratio is capped.
